about: LIN-250/TR-49: same as the "orgs-items" example, but the extra endpoint has THREE path parameters instead of two (/api/orgs/{orgId}/items/{itemId}/reviews/{reviewId}). Before LIN-250/TR-49 a three-or-more-param path was imported and listed but never wired (isWired capped at 2); now it generates its own Service function (all three ids in the signature) the same way the two-param case already did.
